summary: Initial beta release of NutriSize — a health intelligence app for nutrition and exercise.
included: Multi-platform support: iOS (iPhone & iPad), Android, and Web
Basic Health Parameters tracking (age, weight, height, and derived metrics)
Five main sections: MyHealth, Nutrition, Exercise, System, and Nutrisize
System Diagnostics with device hardware info, memory/CPU/storage monitoring, and automated issue reporting
Your Data & Privacy screen — complete guide to how NutriSize handles local data
About, Release Notes, and Support Nutrisize screens
Adjustable display zoom (slider + pinch-to-zoom) for accessibility
First-launch beta notice with feedback guidance
Privacy-first architecture — all data stored locally on your device
coming: Individualized nutrition plans referencing WHO, USDA, and NASEM guidelines
Exercise recommendations based on ACSM standards
Health history tracking with time-series data from wearable devices
